description: Dependency-maintenance Lane A (KB-407, ADR-0015 wave 2) plus Lane B protection + CodeQL triage (KB-409, waves 5-6) and the KB-410 guided-sweep steps (compliance apply + delta report): one deterministic collect sweep (KB-406) feeds a pure-jq classify step (deterministic buckets + consolidated one-carrier-per-module plan), a pure-jq route brief, a decision-adapter gate (proceed or hold; unconfident or undeclared choices hold), a rebase lane (gh pr update-branch with read-back) and a brokenbot-lane merge step (gated carrier merges + close-out of superseded PRs). After the merge lane lands, compliance_apply writes the KB-408 pack's CI template + dependabot.yml per plan repo (every write byte-verified by API read-back), the protect step applies branch-protection rulesets only AFTER per-repo CI is green (never protection-without-signal; every application verified by API read-back against the exact contract), the budgeted codeql_triage step executes the typed CodeQL dispositions (fix rows ride the standard pipeline; suppress rows are typed dismissals-with-rationale capped per run) to drive open alerts to zero and hold, and delta_report records per-repo before/after deltas for the delta-driven weekly cadence. Artifacts (inventory, classification, acts, merged, compliance, protection, codeql_triage, delta) are written under the sweep root on the data lane.
